info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Gardening Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Gardening Notebook Details API enables users to create comprehensive entries for gardening notebooks within a catalog. This endpoint allows the addition of specific details, enhancing the richness of gardening records. Typical consumers include gardening enthusiasts, landscape architects, and botanical researchers who aim to organize and document their gardening activities effectively. By utilizing this API, users can streamline the process of cataloging gardening information and ensure consistent entry of valuable data.

post.summary: Create new details for the gardening notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and add new details to their gardening notebook, helping them to track their gardening activities, plant care, and other gardening-related notes effectively.

requestBody.description: Contains the details required to create or update a gardening notebook entry. This request body should adhere to the defined schema to ensure that all necessary information is provided in a structured format.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details retrieved.
